name: CRA Annex VII draft structure (informational)
description: Structural file/header gates for CRA Annex VII drafts, an Art 14 reporting-path file, and dependency hygiene — not essential-requirements conformity. Informational — not a conformity assessment.

rules.description: CRA Annex VII risk assessment draft missing, too short, or lacking required section headers.
rules.remediation: Populate docs/annex-vii/risk_assessment.md with product-specific risk models (no placeholders). Mention this product (package.json name, go.mod module, or repo directory name) and keep README.md present.
rules.expected: Risk assessment exceeds structural thresholds, contains required headers, and is bound to this repository.

rules.description: Support period rationale missing or incomplete.
rules.remediation: Declare a concrete product support period and rationale in docs/annex-vii/support_period.md. Mention this product (package.json name, go.mod module, or repo directory name).
rules.expected: Support period document present with End of Support section and repo-bound product mention.

rules.remediation: Add Secure Configuration and Product Disposal guidance. Mention this product (package.json name, go.mod module, or repo directory name).
rules.expected: User manual security sections present and bound to this repository.

rules.description: CRA Art 14 reporting path file missing, too short, or lacking required section headers. Structural file gate only — documents the path; does not mean tabletop rehearsed. Not a live SRP or EU Login check; not vulnerability-handling/SPOC evidence.
rules.remediation: Populate docs/incident/art14-path.md with this product's Art 14 reporting path (named owner + Drafted date). Fill Last tabletop: after tabletop for badge rehearsed. Distinguish reporting (11 Sept 2026) from vulnerability-handling/public SPOC (later clock). Do not claim EU Login works. Mention this product (package.json name, go.mod module, or repo directory name).
rules.expected: Art 14 reporting path file present with required headers and a repo-bound product mention. Documented draft only — not a live SRP check; badge shows rehearsed only after human fills Last tabletop:.

rules.description: Annex VII drafts or Art 14 path file contain placeholder / boilerplate text.
rules.remediation: Replace TODO / lorem ipsum / [insert ...] placeholders with real product content.
rules.expected: No placeholder patterns in Annex VII drafts or the Art 14 path file.

rules.description: Vulnerable axios@1.6.0 pin detected in package.json.
rules.remediation: Upgrade axios to a patched release (>=1.8.4 recommended) and refresh the lockfile.
rules.expected: Dependency tree free of listed unmitigated axios pins.
